requirement: Refresh official schedule, standings, team statistics and injury report per rolling slate
status: scripts/refresh_2026_11_16.py reads the official schedule (25 games, 11/16-18), all three official team-stat pages (30 teams re-cut) and the newest official injury report (56 player rows), then writes a 14-gate report.
evidence: 13/14 gates pass; no build-scoped failure; rebuild_allowed true. Gates: F1-F3, P1-P3, I1, I3-I8.

requirement: Rebuild only after freshness and provenance gates pass
status: Gate scope is explicit: build-scoped gates block the rebuild, row-scoped gates withhold their own row. build_round_site.py refuses to write a page whose table row has no official link.
evidence: gates.json: blocking_failures [], rebuild_allowed true. The one failing gate is row-scoped.

requirement: Results feed: one row per game - date, teams, final score, quarter scores
status: results.json holds one row per game with all four (or five) quarter scores, the printed final, the quarter sums and a settlement stamp.
evidence: 9 rows for 2026-11-15; 8 settled, 1 withheld with the conflicting arithmetic printed.

requirement: Settle only after final scores are verified
status: A row settles only if both teams' quarters sum to their printed finals AND the game book's recap restates them. Contradiction withholds the row.
evidence: ATL@MIL withheld; NYK@TOR settled on its period table with the truncated recap recorded.

requirement: Store every injury PDF with a timestamp; diff consecutive reports to detect status changes
status: The raw PDF transcript is committed with its URL and retrieval time; injury_archive.py diffs consecutive stamps on a conservative key.
evidence: 11/16 09:15 AM captured; delta vs 11/15 06:15 AM lists status changes, additions and removals.

requirement: Pre-register a strategy file before its first bet (signal, thresholds, universe, settlement rule)
status: The preregister module writes a frozen record and hashes it; the strategy gate refuses to publish a strategy without one.
evidence: Every strategy row reports preregistered=false and is blocked, which is why 0 are published.

requirement: Tamper-evident ledger: hash each published pick before tip, verify after settlement
status: The ledger module seals a pick with a SHA-256 hash over its canonical fields and re-verifies on settlement.
evidence: No pick is published today, so the ledger is empty; the mechanism is exercised by tests.

requirement: Two surfaces: projection (safe to publish) vs bet (gated), never mixed
status: The navigation separates "Projections - safe to publish" from "Bet surface - gated", and the bet pages state their gate status on every row.
evidence: Strategy board 0/25 published; pricing publishes fair values only, with no offer language.

requirement: Two independent estimators; publish their disagreement as the primary confidence signal, blend underneath
status: A reads final margins only; B reads the official advanced page only. The disagreement is the first numeric column and the confidence pill is derived from it alone; the blend is printed after it.
evidence: 25 lines, disagreement 0.02 to 33.74 points; estimator A walk-forward RMSE 13.43 vs baseline 17.05.

requirement: Home-court advantage pinned to the measured home-win rate, not freely fitted
status: The home-court term is derived from the measured home-win rate and the measured margin spread and is held fixed in both estimators.
evidence: rate 0.5909 on 22 finals, mean margin 2.0, sd 17.93, implied HCA 4.12 points. Pinned, asserted by test.

requirement: Luck as a z-score per team; refuse to publish a strategy leaning on a team outside the noise band
status: luck_z uses a league-pooled residual standard deviation and requires four games before a z is treated as meaningful; the strategy gate blocks on a non-meaningful z.
evidence: All 25 strategies blocked for exactly this reason, with the reason generated per row.

requirement: Rest / B2B / 3-in-4 from the official schedule; travel distance from a sourced arena-coordinate table
status: context.json derives rest days, back-to-backs and 3-in-4 counts from official dates; travel uses a 30-arena coordinate table and names the article per distance.
evidence: Rest is derived from official dates. Travel is labelled SECONDARY because no official coordinate source exists.

requirement: Minutes redistribution: top-8 minute shares and replacement shares when a player is out
status: The minutes module computes shares from per-player logs.
evidence: BLOCKED: no per-player log is captured this round (Q03). No replacement share is published rather than estimating one.

requirement: Parlays priced with measured rho, naive product printed beside it
status: Every parlay carries the naive product and the joint probability from a bivariate normal copula at the measured margin/total rho.
evidence: rho -0.2336 on 22 finals, 95% CI [-0.597, 0.209]; 25 parlays priced both ways; the copula collapses to the product at rho=0 (unit test).

requirement: Rotation availability as its own column on the picks page
status: The slate and injuries pages carry an availability view built from the report's statuses.
evidence: Player-level rotation size is blocked on Q03; availability (the printed status) is published per player.

requirement: Market-anchored prior: blend model with closing line, weighted by measured out-of-sample log-loss
status: The blend weight formula is implemented and printed on the method page; the field is null because no closing-line feed is connected.
evidence: market_prior.available false on all 25 lines; the weight is left null rather than chosen (Q02).

requirement: Totals = possessions x points-per-possession, not the average of team scoring averages
status: The totals model builds possessions from measured PACE and points-per-100 from season points over season possessions, and prints the rejected naive sum beside it.
evidence: Totals 221.8-237.1, each with the naive sum and the delta; three unit-chain checks asserted by test.

requirement: Injuries page banner: revision time and retrieval time
status: The injuries page header prints both the league's report stamp and the instant this build read it, rather than an hours-ago figure that would go stale.
evidence: report stamp 11/16/26 09:15 AM ET; retrieval 2026-11-16T13:25Z.

requirement: Ledger settlement from official finals as soon as each game day ends, with the stamp visible
status: Settlement runs off the results feed, which is read from official game books; the stamp is a column on the results page.
evidence: 8 rows stamped; 1 withheld with its reason published.

requirement: Re-read the three official team-stat pages and re-cut model inputs
status: All three pages re-read and re-cut into one row per team; seven cross-page identities re-derived before anything is published.
evidence: 30 teams; 7/7 identities pass within their rounding bounds.

requirement: Per-player game logs (min, pts, reb, ast, opponent) for at least injury-report players
status: The game-book parser prints per-player lines and validates them against the scoring and rebound identities.
evidence: BLOCKED: this round captured team totals only. The 56 listed players have no log on the site.

requirement: Originate own NBA lines; research signals; single bets, parlays, player-prop combos

evidence: Lines and parlay prices published. Player-prop combos withheld for want of a measured rho.

requirement: Validation gates; correlation values; remove luck; selectively skill-based strategies
status: Gate report with explicit scope, measured rho with a confidence interval, a luck z-score with a minimum-games rule and a strategy gate that blocks on it.
evidence: 13/14 gates pass, 1 row withheld. No strategy survives the luck gate, so none is published.

status: The slate covers 11/16, 11/17 and 11/18 - every official game in the window - with an originated line on each.
evidence: 25 of 25 games have a line. Projections are published; picks are not, because no strategy is funded.

status: The injury pages carry the official status of every listed player and the changes between reports.
evidence: BLOCKED: the minutes impact needs per-player logs (Q03). No minutes or production number is published rather than estimated.

evidence: No step in this round required a value to be supplied.
